plan.title: Subscription Plan
plan.description: Select your plan tier. free=5 basic tools (pattern detection, document list, deadline calc), pro=all 24 tools (AI reason letter, reference forms, SSW2 checklist, OCR), enterprise=audit logs & tenant management

apiKey.title: API Key (Enterprise only)
apiKey.description: API key for Enterprise plan. Not required for free/pro plans. Get yours at the SuguVisa dashboard.

gcpProjectId.title: GCP Project ID (Optional)
gcpProjectId.description: Google Cloud Project ID for residence card OCR (Document AI) and legal document search (Vertex AI). Leave empty if you don't need these features.
